correctness.rationale: Linear initially empty equal-K reservoirs give Gamma/Erlang impulse kernel h_n(x)=x^(n-1) e^-x/(n-1)!. Two equal shifts produce the 4-stage derivative cubic P_s(u). Independent symbolic calculation exactly verified disc(P_s)=-27 e^s s^2 F(s); G=e^-s F decreases strictly on (2,3), changing sign once, and Vieta/Descartes together determine one versus three positive post-pulse derivative roots. Boundary s=3 and s>3, n=2,3, and persistence for fixed s between cutoff and 3 follow by separate derivative-sign arguments and uniform convergence on simple-root neighborhoods. Independent exact symbolic factorization, numerical root 2.95880814824388 and four sample root counts corroborated calculations, not the global analytic uniqueness.

value.rationale: Two storm events can be merged or resolved by a physical linear filter. Exact peak resolution as a function of reservoir depth and scaled separation is a natural hydrology/signal-processing invariant; the four-stage submodal bifurcation and its analytic transcendental cutoff answer a meaningful boundary question and persist under narrow finite-width pulses. It is not a universal claim about nonlinear catchments or noisy observations.
